groups.description: Live employer-bike-leasing and bike-as-a-service operators that this domain is modeled on — useful to see how employer, rider, and dealer surfaces are positioned in practice.

links.title: Lease a Bike — employer bike leasing
links.relevance: The clearest enterprise bike-benefit benchmark, combining employer programs, bike-shop networks, and cross-country rollout — the reference for the Group Mobility and Benefits Director's launch-and-scale job.

links.title: BusinessBike — Dienstrad-Leasing für Arbeitgeber
links.relevance: A major German employer-bike challenger with a digital operating model and broad dealer network — shows the policy, payroll, and retailer mechanics the employer persona must support.

links.title: Swapfiets — bike-as-a-service
links.relevance: The subscription benchmark for rider support, repairs, and urban service logistics — grounds the Urban Knowledge Worker Commuter's expectation of fast service recovery and continuity.

groups.description: Background on cycling as a recognized European transport mode and the policy momentum that shapes employer demand and program design.

links.title: European Declaration on Cycling — EU institutions
links.relevance: Documents the EU-level policy shift that moves company bikes from fringe benefit to mainstream mobility — the macro tailwind behind the employer rollout and adoption jobs.

links.title: European Cycling Declaration progress — ECF
links.relevance: Tracks parking, intermodal, and equity progress that raises adoption potential and informs location-aware launch readiness for the Group Mobility and Benefits Director.

links.title: European Cyclists' Federation
links.relevance: The primary advocacy and data source on European cycling growth and infrastructure — context for ROI framing when bike programs compete against broader mobility budgets.

groups.description: How bike-mobility programs frame service continuity, theft and damage protection, and the cross-country compliance that governs employer leasing.

links.title: Dance — ebike subscription with repairs & theft protection
links.relevance: Shows how maintenance, 24-hour repair SLAs, and theft protection are bundled into the offer — the safety and recovery signals the rider persona evaluates before committing.

groups.description: Resources aimed at the dealer-network and corporate-fleet personas who run handovers, workshops, and shared bike operations.

links.title: BusinessBike • Pon — bike mobility services
links.relevance: Describes the parent-company dealer and partner-network model that the Multi-location Dealer and Service Network Operator persona plugs into for demand, settlement, and service workflows.
